# Cybertron

Cybertron is a retro cyberpunk dark theme inspired by Cyberpunk 2077, Tron, Synthwave and The Terminator. Bold and italic text carry distinct accent colors, and the author suggests pairing the theme with Sliding Panes for a flowing pane layout.

![Cybertron screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nickmilo/Cybertron/HEAD/Cybertron.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Cybertron"
    author: "nickmilo"
    repo:   "nickmilo/Cybertron"
    slug:   "cybertron"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/cybertron"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/nickmilo/Cybertron"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nickmilo/Cybertron/HEAD/Cybertron.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a retro cyberpunk dark theme inspired by Cyberpunk 2077, Tron, Synthwave, and The Terminator. Give bold and italic text distinct accent colors and craft a stylized workspace that encourages creative and analytical focus. Pair with Sliding Panes for a flowing pane layout."
}
```
